M.Arulkani vs The Food Safety Officer on 4 March, 2024 
Author: B.Pugalendhi

 praying for issuance of Writ of Mandamus, directing the respondents

 For Respondent : Mr.A.Baskaran
 Additional Government Ple
 Order
This writ petition is filed seeking a direction to the respondents to grant license to the petitioner to run a beef stall on every Sunday at the back side of his home or any other place in his street by considering the petitioner's representation dated 27.11.2017 2. The petitioner is running a beef stall with the permission of the first respondent from 2013 to 2016 on every Sunday. Thereafter, the respondents have directed the petitioner to get license for running the beef shop. Suddenly, the petitioner met with an accident and therefore, he is not in a position to move from one place to another place. Therefore, he has sent a representation to the respondents to grant licence to run the beef shop in the backyard of the petitioners house. However,
the petitioners representation was considered by the respondent, so far. Therefore, he has filed this writ petition before this Court. 
3. The learned Additional Government pleader appearing for the respondents submits that the backyard of the petitioners house is not a _________ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis suitable place to run a beef shop. The petitioners house is situated in the middle of the residential area and if the permission is granted to the petitioner, it may cause inconvenience to the other people. He further submits that if the petitioner choose any other suitable place, the respondents are ready to consider the petitioners representation as per Section 298 of the Local Bodies Act. 
4. Considering the submission made by the learned Additional Government Pleader, this writ petition is disposed of with a direction to the petitioner to find out an alternative place to run the beef shop and thereafter, give a fresh representation to the respondents and the same shall be considered by the respondents within a period of Eight weeks from the date of receipt of such fresh representation. No Costs.
